operations.description: Create or update user information and traits in LogRocket to contextualize user behavior.

inputs.description: Your LogRocket organization ID (found in Settings > General Settings, or in your App ID before the slash)
inputs.label: Organization ID
inputs.name: orgId

inputs.description: Your LogRocket app/project ID (found in Settings > General Settings, or in your App ID after the slash)
inputs.label: App ID
inputs.name: appId

inputs.description: The unique identifier for the user
inputs.label: User ID
inputs.name: userId

inputs.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds indicating when this data was collected (optional)
inputs.label: Timestamp
inputs.name: timestamp

inputs.description: User traits as key-value pairs (e.g., {"plan": "free", "age": 43}). Values will be converted to strings.
inputs.label: Traits
inputs.name: traits

operations.name: Identify User

operations.description: Request session highlights for a user. Results will be sent to the webhook URL when ready.

inputs.description: Your LogRocket organization ID (found in Settings > General Settings, or in your App ID before the slash)
inputs.label: Organization ID
inputs.name: orgId

inputs.description: Your LogRocket project ID (found in Settings > General Settings, or in your App ID after the slash)
inputs.label: Project ID
inputs.name: projectId

inputs.description: The email of the user to get highlights for
inputs.label: User Email
inputs.name: userEmail

inputs.description: The ID of the user from LogRocket.identify() calls
inputs.label: User ID
inputs.name: userId

inputs.description: Start of the time range for sessions (optional)
inputs.label: Start Time
inputs.name: timeRangeStart

inputs.description: End of the time range for sessions (optional)
inputs.label: End Time
inputs.name: timeRangeEnd

inputs.description: URL where highlights results will be posted when ready. You can get this from the "Highlights Ready" trigger.
inputs.label: Webhook URL
inputs.name: webhookUrl

operations.name: Request Highlights

operations.description: Trigger when session highlights are ready. Use this webhook URL when requesting highlights.
operations.name: Highlights Ready
